text.en: A frog's tadpole breathes with gills, as a fish does.
A polar bear decides to grow thick fur after it moves somewhere cold.

modelCorrection.en: No animal chooses its adaptations. Over many generations, inherited features that help animals survive and have young become more common.

text.en: Laying eggs is enough to tell a reptile from a bird.

modelCorrection.en: Reptiles and birds both lay eggs, so eggs alone cannot separate them. Body covering can: dry scales for a reptile, feathers for a bird.

text.en: A camel's hump is a store of fat, not of water.
